notes: Tom Ford FT1123-D 26E 49 (catalog listing): round panto sunglasses in clear crystal ('champagne') acetate. The front, bridge, endpieces and temples are transparent: the lens edges and the hinges show through the acetate. A thin gold metal core wire runs inside each clear temple from the hinge to the tip; a flat gold-tone 'T' inlay sits on the outer face of each temple at the hinge; a small gold oval plaque on the underside near each temple tip. Lenses: flat, light brown flash-mirror (champagne gold reflection), with a small grey 'TOM FORD' print in the upper outer area of the right lens. No physical dimensions supplied. The runtime renders a translucent FRONT (gl.material_translucent, a near-white crystal tint); temples are exported opaque in this release, so give them the closest opaque look (a pale warm ivory acetate) with the gold accents.
